y = selective_scan_metal(u, delta, B_in, C_in, A_neg)
mx.eval(y)
print(f'SSM Metal output shape: {y.shape} - OK')

# Quick GLA test
q = mx.random.normal((1, 32, 2, 8)) * 0.125
k = mx.random.normal((1, 32, 2, 8))
v = mx.random.normal((1, 32, 2, 8))
gates = mx.sigmoid(mx.random.normal((1, 32, 2)))
mx.eval(q, k, v, gates)

o = gla_scan_metal(q, k, v, gates)
mx.eval(o)
print(f'GLA Metal output shape: {o.shape} - OK')
print('Package imports and runs correctly!')
"
